nodes.text:
1/ 📈 WWSCAN Weekly Data

Respiratory weekly update: SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category. The other respiratory viruses we monitor (RSV, Influenza A, Influenza B, HMPV and EV-D68) are in the ‘Low’ category nationwide and not in seasonal onset. https://t.co/GYtux70LCc

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 2/ COVID-19: Nationwide, SARS-CoV-2 is in the ‘Medium’ category with medium concentrations and no significant trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/g3y8sSTise

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 3/ COVID-19 Variants: In sequencing data from a subset of WWSCAN sites, the LP.8.1 variant  (descendant of KP.1) in brown (68.5%) & other KP.1 variants in light green (25.6%) make up around 94% of variants. Note sequencing data has a longer lag of 1-2 weeks after collection. https://t.co/j9f6XXMGMq

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 4/ Influenza: Nationally, Flu A and Flu B are in the ‘Low’ category and not in seasonal onset. About 22% and 48% of sites are in seasonal onset for Flu A and Flu B, respectively. https://t.co/50RAxNnlRL

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 5/ H5 influenza marker: H5 has been detected in 26 states since monitoring began - 6 in the West, 7 in the Midwest, 7 in the South, & 6 in the Northeast. As of 5/7/25, 17 states have also reported infected cattle herds. The most recent wastewater detections have been in CA & NJ. https://t.co/uCnQIWZAO3

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 6/ RSV: RSV is in the ‘Low’ category nationally and not in seasonal onset. About 25% of sites are still in seasonal onset for RSV. https://t.co/Wlx0rJhZiN

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 7/ HMPV: HMPV is in the ‘High’ category nationally with high concentrations and a downward trend. 46.5% of sites are now in seasonal onset for HMPV, which is near the national onset threshold. https://t.co/UYSOufDCgh

nodes.author: rmchavin
nodes.text:
WastewaterSCAN reports that norovirus cases are finally tapering off due to the warmer temperatures of mid-spring:
https://t.co/n5issJbN80
WastewaterSCAN reports that human metapneumovirus has apparently evolved to become somewhat resistant to solar warmth
https://t.co/1tEa4IpwZF

nodes.author: WastewaterSCAN
nodes.text: 8/ Norovirus: Norovirus is in the ‘Medium’ category nationally with medium concentrations and a downward trend over the last 3 weeks. https://t.co/QrlfYMvymK
